name: page-design-review
description: Review a page against its users’ task and apply selected design fixes in a local workspace.

interface.longDescription: Review a screenshot or browser page for typography, layout, interaction, visual design, and motion. Get evidence and prioritized fixes. Select findings to preview or apply in your local project.
interface.defaultPrompt: Review this page for its primary task. Rank the fixes and let me choose which to apply.
